content.text: All gates pass. Committing Phase 4 and tagging it `compaction-v4`. The push hook runs the typecheck.

input.command:
cd "C:/Users/shrey/desktop/Elemental_harness" && git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Stop a turn when automatic compaction keeps thrashing

When pressure compactions come within 3 steps of each other 3 times in
a row, the pre-step listener throws CompactionThrashError and the turn
ends with an actionable error naming the likely oversized file or tool
output. thrashWindowSteps and thrashLimit tune it; 0 disables.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log -1 --oneline; git push -q -u origin compaction-phase4 2>&1 | grep -E "✔|✖|error" | tail -3; git tag -a compaction-v4 -m "Phase 4: compaction thrash guard" && git push -q origin refs/tags/compaction-v4 2>&1 | tail -1; git ls-remote origin refs/tags/compaction-v4 refs/heads/compaction-phase4
